about_the_game:
Royal Society of Mythology

The world's myths never died. They just went underground.

Dragons.

Faerie trees.

Fountains of youth.

Miraculous plants.

Monsters in the dark.

Every culture tells stories of things that couldn't possibly exist--creatures and relics so powerful they were woven into legend. Most people dismiss these tales as superstition or metaphor. But the Royal Society of Mythology knows better.

And so do its rivals.

---------------------------------

Royal Society of Mythology is a mini-setting for Savage Worlds Adventure Edition, packed with mythic intrigue, shadowy factions, and globe-spanning action. You play agents of a secret society dedicated to uncovering the truth behind the world's folklore and keeping that truth out of the wrong hands.

One week you're navigating jungle ruins. The next, you're bidding on dragon teeth at a black-market auction in Istanbul. Then it's off to Iceland to negotiate with a very real and very territorial troll.

At the heart of Royal Society of Mythology are Myth Hunts--dangerous, globe-spanning missions where agents track down legendary creatures, arcane plants, and magical artifacts. You'll face ancient guardians, rival factions, and moral dilemmas as you uncover long-lost secrets buried beneath centuries of lies and protective magics.

Each Myth Hunt is part expedition, part investigation, part survival story: Do you extract the creature--or protect it? Will you share your findings--or bury them? And who's already there with a private security team and a stolen RSM badge?

The Competition Is Fierce (and Occasionally Flirty)

The Royal Society isn't alone out there. Several other organizations are in play--some harmless, some hostile, and some waiting to pull the classic Belloq Maneuver (named for the iconic betrayal in the opening of Raiders of the Lost Ark ).
